verdict.rationale: Penpot is well known as open-source (GitHub repo referenced) and docs emphasize open standards, open file format, and self-hosting, which implies source availability, but the evidence pack lacks an explicit statement of the license type or direct pointer to license terms. missing for 10: explicit license name/terms (e.g. MPL-2.0) cited in docs, confirmation that full source (not just plugin API) is published under that license.
